name: Searchable lists
description: Search for SwiftUI lists: locale-aware matching across several fields, a debounced query for remote search, and the system empty state for no results.
usage: Attach `.searchable(text: $query)` to the list's NavigationStack content and filter in the view model with `items.filter { $0.title.matchesSearch(query) || $0.body.matchesSearch(query) }` (case and diacritic insensitive, every word must match). When results are empty and the query is not, show `SearchNoResultsView(query:)`. For network search, debounce with `.task(id: query) { try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(300)); await model.search(query) }`.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify search` on a Mac.
